# CM24: attaining the multipoint external-observer bound by finite-field trace

Status: author proof, pending independent review. This is a direct supporting research activity, not an execution or completion of any formal CM Task. It closes the explicit decoder gap left in section 6 of the earlier minimal-endpoint-jet paper, within its ambient enlarged-carrier domain. The earlier lower bound is reused. No value of Y, Z, h_div or kappa is asserted, and no fixed-forcing family is enlarged.

Author: EM-DIRECT-38A864. Activity: RA-BALANCE-CM-20261028-38A864. The session key is locally assigned, not platform attested. Startup registration was read in full at immutable Source commit 2a81170fdfe6605608a596446e78e7dabbc27df0; the native guard returned activity_allowed=true and no formal Task authority. Shared control and existing-source exposure are disclosed; this is not blind discovery.

## 1. Exact question, carrier, and reused result

Let p=6m+1 be prime, p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24, m>=2, and N=3m. Work over the external arithmetic field F_p. All polynomial exponents remain literal integers. Set

    V={B in F_p[z]: deg B<=p-2, [z^N]B=0},
    q(x)=x(x-3)^2/4,
    W_B=x^(-N)(x-3)B(q(x))/24,
    P_B=Pi_[0,N] W_B,  U_B=W_B-P_B.

The whole central polynomial P_B is supplied. Let a_1,...,a_s be pairwise distinct elements of F_p, let d_i>=1, and assume D=sum d_i<=m. The requested outputs are the D Hasse coefficients

    beta_(i,k)(B)=[v^k]B(a_i+v),  0<=k<d_i.

The 2026-10-14 source `CM24_MINIMAL_ENDPOINT_JET_OBSERVER_20261014.md`, section 6, proves that at least D independent F_p-linear external scalars are necessary, or p^D distinct encoding values on every nonempty central fiber. It explicitly does not give an arbitrary-endpoint local decoder. Sections 2--4 of that source supply the low-degree invisible subspace and the triangular construction at a=1, x=4. We reuse those facts and extend the explicit construction to every stated a_i, including a=0 and endpoints without a rational unramified preimage.

Source provenance: `research_notes/ROOT_THREE_PAPER_UNITS_AND_OWNER_NEXT_PLAN_20261014_FBF223.json` at commit 56f5938da3f707c1d9db1b39afde124eac4634e3, member `/workspace/em-owner-resume-20261011/new-round-20261011/CM24_MINIMAL_ENDPOINT_JET_OBSERVER_20261014.md`. Exact extracted member: 12768 bytes, SHA256 `9df43a752608954cc2d103e40a4db911064c3e5fbad0d9fae1a2bc0690436df8`, Git blob `eb34557f767e21e441ec512b28491f0611a6c127`. The published monthly library records it as CM-AN-MINIMAL-ENDPOINT-JETS. Bounded current commit searches for CM24 endpoint/adjoint/multipoint found no later multipoint decoder; this is not an exhaustive literature-novelty claim. Today's D25 Legendre/Clausen digit work is a different exact interface and is not repeated.

P000/Heartbeat typing: the project's native spatial substrate remains the signed six-axis discrete Cell torsor, with no native plane. The finite polynomial, extension field, and jets here are external arithmetic observers, not spatial axes, physical time, or a new native ontology. Full central and outer blocks remain retained until the stated observer certificate applies. The result concerns only the named finite target language, not future operations that have not been declared.

## 2. Unramified preimages of every endpoint

For a in F_p choose a finite extension E/F_p of degree e<=3 and alpha in E as follows.

* If a=0, take E=F_p and alpha=0.
* If a=1, take E=F_p and alpha=4.
* Otherwise choose any monic irreducible factor f of `x(x-3)^2-4a`, put E=F_p[x]/(f), and let alpha be the residue class of x.

The polynomial is cubic, so 1<=e<=3. Its derivative is 3(x-1)(x-3); a repeated root could occur only above a=1 or a=0. Thus in the third case every factor is separable, alpha is neither 0 nor 3, and q'(alpha) is nonzero. The first two displayed choices also have q'(alpha)=9/4. In every case alpha-3 is a unit, e is a unit in F_p, and

    H_alpha(t)=q(alpha+t)-a
              =lambda t+mu t^2+(1/4)t^3,
    lambda=(3/4)(alpha-1)(alpha-3) != 0,
    mu=(3/4)(alpha-2).

Selection and validation of a factor are actual preprocessing obligations. They depend only on p and the prescribed endpoint, never on B or its target values. No rational preimage is assumed when one is unavailable.

## 3. A uniform normalization, including the pole at zero

Every W_B, P_B and U_B has exponents at least -N. For any such finite Laurent polynomial T over F_p define the polynomial Q_T=x^N T and the local power series

    R_(alpha,T)(t)=24 Q_T(alpha+t)/(alpha+t-3) in E[[t]].      (1)

The denominator is a unit for all selected alpha. This definition is valid at alpha=0: the pole of T is canceled by x^N before taking local coefficients. It never evaluates a pole of W_B or drops negative outer exponents. For the full carrier the identity is exact:

    R_(alpha,W_B)(t)=B(q(alpha+t))=B(a+H_alpha(t)).          (2)

For 0<=j<=k<d write A_(k,j)=[t^k]H_alpha(t)^j. This is lower triangular with diagonal A_(k,k)=lambda^k. Define E-valued linear functionals recursively:

    L_(alpha,0)(T)=[t^0]R_(alpha,T),
    L_(alpha,k)(T)=lambda^(-k)([t^k]R_(alpha,T)
                         -sum_(j=0)^(k-1) A_(k,j)L_(alpha,j)(T)).  (3)

No factorial is inverted. Coefficient comparison in (2), followed by triangular substitution, gives

    L_(alpha,k)(W_B)=beta_(a,k)(B) in F_p subset E.          (4)

Although (4) is base-field valued, its central and outer summands separately need not be. Reporting e coordinates for each summand would fail to attain the known D-scalar bound. The required descent is the normalized field trace:

    ell_(alpha,k)(T)=e^(-1) Tr_(E/F_p)(L_(alpha,k)(T)).      (5)

This is an actual F_p-linear scalar functional. Since Tr(b)=eb for b in F_p, equation (4) becomes ell_(alpha,k)(W_B)=beta_(a,k)(B).

The extension field is a computation representation, not extra retained output coordinates. In particular, merely declaring an E-valued observation to be one F_p scalar would be incorrect; (5) is the explicit descent that pays this difference.

## 4. Main theorem: the lower bound is attained at all prescribed points

For each i make the above choice (E_i,alpha_i,e_i), and retain exactly

    O_(i,k)(B)=ell_(alpha_i,k)(U_B),  0<=k<d_i.             (6)

Then these D base-field scalars and P_B reconstruct all requested targets by

    beta_(i,k)(B)=ell_(alpha_i,k)(P_B)+O_(i,k)(B).          (7)

Proof. Equations (1)--(5) are valid for the full carrier and for each of its two summands, and are linear in T. Apply them to W_B=P_B+U_B. This proves (7), without any source-dependent solve, target-defined coefficient, omitted block, or guessed endpoint constant.

For completeness, the exact independence statement follows by the already-used Hermite argument. The map from polynomials L of degree<D to the D Hasse jets at the distinct a_i is an isomorphism, since the ideals (z-a_i)^(d_i) are pairwise coprime and their product has degree D. Such L lie in ker C: degree((x-3)L(q))<=3(D-1)+1<=N-2, so W_L has only negative exponents. Thus on this D-dimensional subspace equation (7) identifies O with the target-jet isomorphism. Hence the D observers are independent modulo the central data. An exact decoder using fewer than D F_p-linear external scalars would identify two members of this subspace with different target jets, even if its decoding rule were nonlinear. The existing alphabet bound p^D follows by the same restriction on each nonempty affine central fiber. QED.

The new content is the matching upper construction (1)--(7) for every prescribed endpoint, with field descent and the zero-pole correction. The lower bound and the a=1,alpha=4 special case retain their original authorship and are not counted again.

## 5. Sharp local coefficient budgets

At alpha!=0 the factor 24(alpha+t)^N/(alpha+t-3) is a unit. Consequently local Hasse coefficients of T through order d-1 suffice to compute (1)--(3). At alpha=0, coefficients of Q_T=t^N T through order d-1 suffice. In terms of T these are the actual Laurent coefficients with exponents -N,...,-N+d-1; ordinary nonnegative Taylor jets at zero are not defined for the unnormalized carrier.

These thresholds are sharp when all prescribed local jets through order d_j-1 at the other selected points are also given. Fix i. Hermite interpolation supplies a polynomial L_i of degree<D whose requested jets are zero except beta_(i,d_i-1)=1. It is in ker C. At alpha_i, equation (2) has exact order d_i-1 because H_alpha has order one. Multiplication by alpha_i+t-3 is a unit, so Q_(W_Li)(alpha_i+t) has exact order d_i-1. At every other selected alpha_j its order is at least d_j. Thus L_i and zero have identical central data and identical local data through order d_i-2 at i and d_j-1 elsewhere, but different requested top jet at i. Neither a linear nor nonlinear decoder can recover that omitted jet from those data. This remains valid if the corresponding finite jets at every conjugate root are supplied: the same order argument holds at every conjugate root. For d_i=1, 'through order -1' means no local coefficient at that point.

For nonzero alpha_i, the same threshold applies to W itself. For alpha_i=0 it is the Laurent exponent -N+d_i-1 after the stated normalization. This is a local information threshold; it is not a lower bound on every possible arithmetic algorithm or a physical measurement-cost claim.

## 6. Effective computation and costs

All constructions are finite and depend on declared input data. Given the selected factors, field arithmetic uses extension degree at most three. The matrix A can be formed by the recurrence for powers of the cubic H, with O(d_i^2) field operations. Equation (3) is a triangular substitution of the same order. R can be computed by truncated Horner evaluation of Q_T at alpha_i+t and the recurrence for division by the linear unit alpha_i-3+t. If Q_T has degree at most L, this costs O(L d_i+d_i^2) extension operations. Trace can be computed as the trace of multiplication by the element in the fixed basis, so its cost is bounded in extension degree; it is not an additional output datum.

For the present carriers deg Q_T<=6N-2, including both actual outer blocks. A direct implementation therefore uses O(ND+D^2) base-field operations after the factor choices and field representations are supplied, with fixed constants from e_i<=3. Finding/validating irreducible factors, constructing representations, reading the full blocks, and storing the central data are separate real costs. No improvement over an existing full-carrier algorithm is claimed. One can instead use the explicit local input coefficients described in section 5 if they are already genuinely available.

## 7. Scope, harvest, and next genuine boundaries

This is `COMPOSE_APPLIED`: the previous kernel/Hermite lower bound and triangular pullback are composed with ordinary finite-field trace. It is `RESULT_ONLY_STANDARD_COMPOSE`, not a new toolbox family. Current toolbox coverage was run before construction and retained in `tool_coverage.json`; a catalogue match is not counted as execution of a theorem.

The exact observer task is closed by the proof, subject to independent review. It does not furnish the outer data from a central forcing. It does not apply the ambient D-defect to a fixed full-forcing singleton; that defect must still be computed on its actual allowed variation space. Cases D>m remain outside the lower-bound equality claim. Simultaneous future operations not factoring through the selected finite jets are also outside scope.

CM finite h_div/Y/Z/kappa evaluation, fixed-source connection, integral/proper comparisons, and parent objectives remain open. The next portfolio step should service an unserved algebra obligation or review an existing pending CM result rather than create another endpoint variant merely because this one succeeded.
